recent_articles.rephrased_article: **I4C** has issued an advisory warning of a new phishing scam targeting Apple users. Perpetrators impersonate Apple Support officials, exploiting victims' urgency to locate or secure their missing devices through fraudulent SMS messages containing phishing links. These messages appear legitimate and redirect users to counterfeit Apple login pages designed to steal Apple ID credentials and one-time passwords (OTP). Once the stolen device is compromised, attackers gain unauthorized access to victims’ accounts and remove the linked Apple IDs from the devices.  The government advisory recommends avoiding clicking links received through SMS or unsolicited messages, verifying website addresses before entering credentials, and using official Apple channels for verification.
